descricao: The nuclear reactor of the Ace of Spades is still operational, and despite the wear on the outside of the hull, the interior remains intact. There are several refrigerators inside the Ace of Spades that contain bottled water and several food items, such as sandwiches, pasta, fruits, vegetables, eggs, and meat. When removed from the refrigerators, the items will eventually restock, meaning that the Ace of Spades contains an infinite supply of food and water. When entering Level 83, wanderers will always find themselves inside the berth or the canteen of the Ace of Spades.
